errors.description: bond_state_q is a multi-bit value produced in lane_clk and sampled directly in pcs_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
bond_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle lane_clk pulse consumed directly in pcs_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
bond_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample pcs_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in pcs_event_o.
bond_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector bond_mode_q before decoding in pcs_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
lane_rst_n is used as data inside pcs_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines lane_clk payload state with pcs_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
